title: Captain Isla’s Secret Mark
moral: The best treasure is what we share with others.

scenes.summary: Captain Isla begins a journey to the Isle of Echoes.
scenes.text: Captain Isla sailed on The Merry Turtle with her crew, excited to explore the Isle of Echoes.

story: Captain Isla sailed on The Merry Turtle with her crew to find adventure. They followed a magical map through dangerous rocks and reached the Isle of Echoes. Inside a cave, Isla solved a riddle and found a treasure. Instead of keeping it, she chose to hide it for future adventurers. The crew sailed away, knowing that sharing and kindness were the greatest treasures.
